name: Service Operations Management
description: This course introduces students to key concepts and practices of Service Operations Management, focusing on how organizations design, manage, and improve delivery to create customer value. It covers "breakthrough" services and successful firm benchmarks, the "state of the art" in service management thinking, and the application of these principles to improve satisfaction and organizational performance.
